selection: All ordinary program-journal records in fixed rounds775..5049; no outcome, complexity or score filtering. All182earlier records are excluded from plotted counts but available for predecessor lookup.
matching: Within each training context, retain highest earlier logged new_utility and all complexity counts tied at that value. Match only when it equals the current old_utility exactly and the prior count is unambiguous. Unmatched values stay missing, never zero.
complexity_measure: Count of opening parentheses in logged program DSL; a representation count, not an independent quality metric.
change_definition: prior_form_count - candidate_form_count; positive means fewer counted forms in the promoted program.
scope: Adaptive training-program promotions, conditional on admission. Complexity changes do not measure predictive improvement, adapter retention or neural-writer/ranking-map learning. No attempt or throughput denominator is supplied.
source_binding: Exact runtime, candidate-pool/input closure, normalization, checkpoint acceptance and independent first-proposal learning remain unqualified.
source_record_hash_encoding: SHA256 of raw JSONL line including LF terminator
